message: So, the other day we had a little blackout in our neighborhood, and let me tell you, it turned into an impromptu comedy show! I watched my husband try to light candles while holding a flashlight in his mouth—classic. If you ever find yourself in a similar situation, I came across a great resource that covers what to do during power outages. It’s all about keeping calm and making the best of it! What’s your funniest blackout story?
